import pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
b='/target/debug/just'
def case(label,text,args):
 d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/work/tmp'))
 (d/'justfile').write_text(text)
 try:
  p=subprocess.run([b,'--unstable',*args],cwd=d,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
  print(label, p.returncode, repr(p.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[:300]),repr(p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[:600]))
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: print(label,'TIMEOUT')
case('datetime-invalid',"x := datetime('%Q')\n",['--evaluate'])
case('datetime-utc-invalid',"x := datetime_utc('%')\n",['--evaluate'])
case('fn-override',"x := 'original'\nf() := x\ny := f()\n",['--evaluate','x=override'])

case('fn-recur',"f() := f()\nx := f()\n",['--evaluate'])
case('fn-duplicate-param',"f(x, x) := x\ny := f('a', 'b')\n",['--evaluate'])
case('fn-global-command',"x := `echo side-effect >&2; echo result`\nf() := x\ny := f()\n",['--evaluate'])

cat > /work/tmp/module_probes.py <<'PY'
import pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
b='/target/debug/just'
def case(label,files,args):
 d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/work/tmp'))
 for name,text in files.items():
  (d/name).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); (d/name).write_text(text)
 try:
  p=subprocess.run([b,*args],cwd=d,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
  print(label,p.returncode,repr(p.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[:500]),repr(p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[:700]))
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: print(label,'TIMEOUT')
files={'justfile':"mod a 'shared.just'\nmod b 'shared.just'\n",'shared.just':"x := module_path()\nr:\n @echo {{module_path()}} {{x}}\n"}
case('module-reused-a',files,['a','r'])
case('module-reused-ab',files,['a','r','b','r'])
case('module-reused-eval',files,['--evaluate','a::x'])
case('mod-ambiguous-parent',{'justfile':"mod a '../outside'\n",'../outside/mod.just':'r:','../outside/justfile':'s:'},['--list'])
case('mod-self-dot',{'justfile':"mod a 'sub/../justfile'\n",'sub/keep':''},['--list'])
case('cycle-siblings',{'justfile':"mod a\nmod b\n",'a.just':"mod b 'b.just'\n",'b.just':"mod a 'a.just'\n"},['--list'])
PY

import subprocess,pathlib
b='/target/debug/just'; p=pathlib.Path('/work/tmp/parse-panic.just')
for text in ["a := if 'x' == 'y' { 'a' } else { 'b' }\n\t\\", "a := 'b'\n\t\\", "a:\n\t\\", "\t\\", "a:\n \\", "a:\n echo \\", "a:\n  echo \\\n", "a:\n  echo \\\n  ","a:\n  \\\n"]:

 print(repr(text),r.returncode,r.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[:4500])
